Example for two fields: ["person.full_name","person.dob"]
If no fact fits a field, use the string "none".

person.full_name, person.dob, person.nationality, person.phone.mobile, person.email, address.current.line1, address.current.city, address.current.postcode, address.previous.line1, identity.id_number, identity.id_issued, identity.id_expiry, education.institution, education.programme, education.year, education.gpa, employment.employer, employment.role, employment.income_annual, finance.bank_name, finance.account_number, finance.statement_date, referee.1.name, referee.1.phone, skills.list, person.summary

Fields, in order:
1. Full name
2. Date of birth
3. Programme
4. Institution
5. Cumulative grade point average
6. Annual household income (INR)
7. Residential address
8. Mobile number
9. Referee name
